purpose: serve content quickly and safely from locations close to users, with caching rules that are correct and reversible
entry_criteria: Traffic patterns and cacheable content are identified
Purge and rollback process is known
procedure: Classify content by cacheability: static assets, public pages, personalized or private responses.
Set cache keys, time-to-live values and headers per class; never cache private or personalized responses publicly.
Configure origin protection so users cannot bypass the edge and the origin accepts only edge traffic.
Enable TLS, security headers and rate limiting or web-application rules at the edge.
Test cache behavior with repeated requests and with varying headers; test purge and a rollback of the configuration.
Monitor hit rate, origin load and edge errors.
deliverables: test results for caching and purge
acceptance_criteria: Private responses are never publicly cached
The origin accepts only edge traffic
Purge works within the target time
Hit rate and origin load are monitored

validation.expect: long cache lifetime and a cache hit on repeat

failure_modes.response: Mark as private and purge now; treat as an incident
Restrict the origin to edge addresses
Use versioned asset names and purge

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Static assets get a one-year lifetime with versioned names, the account page is no-store, and a test shows a cache hit on the second request for an asset and none for the account page.
